name: Can crown molding be installed on textured ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Can crown molding be installed on textured ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, crown molding can be installed on textured ceilings, but it may require additional preparation to ensure a clean and secure fit. For heavily textured ceilings (like popcorn ceilings), some texture may need to be carefully removed along the line where the molding will sit to create a smooth surface for adhesion. This helps in achieving a seamless look and preventing gaps. Our team assesses the ceiling texture during the consultation and advises on any necessary preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but heavily textured ceilings may require preparation, like localized texture removal, for a clean and secure fit.
